messages:
maria: T-minus 5h to the change window for the EU rollout. Quick sweep: can we pin the deploy to v3.4.1-canary for this window? I want the manual pin in place before we start traffic shift.

deploy-bot: @maria received. Pin request queued: /deploy pin release=v3.4.1-canary target=eu --confirm to apply. Current locks: none.

jon: smoke tests on staging passed earlier. I left the failing embed test tickets linked in the release notes but they were non-blocking. :thumbsup:

priya: Release notes link: https://internal.docs/redwood/releases/3.4.1 - added the rollback steps and perf numbers. Note: embeddings latency regressed 8% at p95 on one sample — flagged in Optimize.

alex: For manual rollback if needed: run these from the ops box (ssh ops@deploy):
```
# rollback to last stable
/deploy promote release=v3.3.9 target=eu --strategy=immediate
# emergency unpin
/deploy unpin target=eu
```
Pager/phone contacts: ENG-SRE oncall -> @dave (pager: pagerdave+eu), Backup -> @jon (pager: pagerjon).

dave: Got it. I'll be on-call during the window and standing by on the ops bridge. If we see >2% error spike or 5s latency tail increase, notify SRE and initiate canary drain.

maria: Alex — please apply the pin when you have the confirm flag set. I want to avoid automatic canary rotation during the first hour.

alex: Applying now: /deploy pin release=v3.4.1-canary target=eu --confirm
deploy-bot: Pin applied by alex at request of maria. Pin ID: pin-20260401-7a9c. Autoscaler will be restricted for first hour per safety policy.

jon: Kicking off preflight smoke: loadgen at 10rps for 10min against canary endpoints. I'll post results.

priya: Reminder: docs & release notes patch: add the exact rollback command (copy-paste) and contact roster at top. New link updated.

dave: Ops bridge link: https://meet.internal/ops/eu-1758. Oncall voice channel open.

maria: If anything looks off during the first 15m of warmup, we abort traffic shift and run alex's promote command. Otherwise proceed with 10% traffic ramp every 10min.

jon: Warmup complete — error rate steady, p95 latency +1%. Proceeding to 10% traffic shift in 5m.

dave: Oncall monitoring: no alerts. I have pager in hand. :ok_hand:

maria: Great. Keep messages here short and call the pager if you need immediate escalation. If we need emergency unpin, @alex you have the token.

dave: Acknowledged.

alex: Token confirmed. Leaving notes in the release doc with exact sequence.

maria: Thanks team — I'll post final handoff at T-minus 30m. :rocket:
